mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_observation WHERE observed_on >= #{date} ORDER BY indicator, observed_on
SELECT FROM market_observation WHERE indicator = #{indicator} AND observed_on = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_observation (indicator, observed_on, observed_value, source, fetched_at, available_at) VALUES (#{indicator}, #{date}, #{value}, #{source}, #{fetchedAt}, #{availableAt})
mapper.select: SELECT source, status, message, attempted_at FROM market_input_source ORDER BY source
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_input_source (source, status, message, attempted_at) VALUES (#{source}, #{status}, #{message}, #{attemptedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE market_input_source SET status = #{status}, message = #{message}, attempted_at = #{attemptedAt} WHERE source = #{source}
